data.name: Fey Summons
data.description: A first worlder adds the following creatures to the lists of what he can summon with his summon nature's ally spell-like ability:&nl; Summon nature's ally II: gremlin (jinkin, pugwampi, or vexgit).&nl; Summon nature's ally III: gremlin (nuglub).&nl; Summon nature's ally IV: unicorn.&nl; Summon nature's ally V: pixie, satyr.&nl; Summon nature's ally VII: nymph.
